summary: Added a deterministic structured_writing_plan surface to analyze_payload. It links required outline sections, draft paragraphs, claim markers, and request-local evidence items using existing lexical helpers. The feature is additive: existing status/issues/score/writing_state behavior is unchanged. It does not query the library database, call external services, perform semantic entailment, or format DOCX.
implemented: backend/server.py: added _payload_evidence_search_items(evidence), adapting payload evidence into stable local search-like items payload-evidence-N/payload-document-N without mutating the payload.
backend/server.py: added build_structured_writing_plan(payload, analysis), returning method=structured_writing_plan_v1, genre, outline, paragraphs, and summary.
Outline entries include section, present, and paragraph_indexes based on exact section-text matching in draft paragraphs.
Paragraph entries include 1-based index, text, deterministic section assignment, required_markers, evidence_map, status, linked_chunk_ids, and warnings.

Paragraph status is no_claim_markers when no required markers exist, supported when every required marker is covered by request-local evidence, and needs_verification when required markers are missing.
analyze_payload now attaches analysis['structured_writing_plan'] before writing_state. Existing analysis keys and writing_state semantics are preserved.
tools/run_quality_gates.py py-compile gate now includes tests/test_structured_writing_plan.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary: request-local evidence only, no DB query, no model call, no NLI/semantic entailment.
not_implemented: No semantic entailment/NLI and no claim truth judgment beyond existing lexical marker coverage.
No library database retrieval; only payload['evidence'] is used.
No LLM calls, no DOCX formatting, no locked paragraph diff/rollback, and no targeted rewrite implementation.
No frontend rendering for structured_writing_plan in this slice.

python tools/validate_retrieval_suite.py --suite tests/data/retrieval_eval_suite.json --json: passed=true, with expected placeholder/<50-case warnings.
risks: structured_writing_plan is deterministic linkage metadata only; it must not be treated as semantic support, legal/policy correctness, or final review.
Section assignment is exact text matching against required section labels. This is intentionally conservative and may miss paraphrased headings.
Payload evidence item conversion is local and stable, but it is not a substitute for trusted library retrieval or persistent chunk IDs.
